rationale: The plan matches the reference on every axis: DESeq2 Wald with apeglm on raw Salmon counts for an unpaired 6 vs 6 single-batch design, with an edgeR QL cross-check and intersection reported as high-confidence. QC is specific to the dataset: blind VST PCA and distance heatmap with sample_01 labeled, library size versus cohort median, and an explicit keep/remove decision requiring a stated reason beyond depth. Pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smaller group) is minimal and justified; normalization is inside the model (median-of-ratios, TMM); design ~condition with control as explicit reference and a named contrast; BH at alpha=0.05 passed to results() with shrunken effects. Enrichment uses the full Wald-statistic ranked list, Hallmark v2026.1 with size 15-500, and explicitly declines ORA on a short list, though the Reactome secondary version is only vaguely 'current'. The report enumerates versions, thresholds, tested/DE counts, the sample_01 decision, and reproducibility details.
